summary: Quiet residential kerb with houses 12-15 m away on the same side.
reasons: Houses 14-15 m away on this side
Flat, wide enough to pull in

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings at 14 m (51 m), 15 m (71 m) and 12 m (89 m) on the section's own side; every stretch has a house within 10-17 m. Bush only at the far east end.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed residential street running to a turning head; parked cars are visible in both images, so there is kerbside room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet local street, little through traffic. It ends at a bend beside bush.
drivers.convention: A few cars park along the street, but there is no sign of campervans or overnight use.

flags: Flat: about 0.9% grade over the section (mean 2.6%, max 8.6% at the western end)
Waterway (Witton Creek) 157 m away; elevation about 35 m, not low-lying
Mapped gate 287 m away has a way round it
sun_shade: Mostly open road with tree shade from the north-side gardens; morning sun from the east, afternoon sun across the road.

best_section.where: Mid-street on the north side, between two houses, beside the hedged gardens
